import gzip,json,collections
from factor_engine.api.dsl_parser import DSLParser
from factor_engine.tools.catalog_sketch_migration import migrate_catalog_sketch_formula
parser=DSLParser(surface="compat_research"); statuses=collections.Counter(); examples={}; total=0
with gzip.open("evidence/factor_catalog_20260915/input.jsonl.gz","rt") as f:
 for line in f:
  s=json.loads(line).get("formula")
  if not isinstance(s,str): continue
  r=migrate_catalog_sketch_formula(s,enabled=True,parser=parser)
  if r.status != "not_complete_sketch":
   total+=1; statuses[r.status]+=1; examples.setdefault(r.status,s)
print("complete_bracket_candidates",total)
for k,v in sorted(statuses.items()): print(k,v,repr(examples[k]))
